input: # field.exact is HEADER-relative and SHAPE-independent: it needs a known
# field list (the header row, or field.names), but it must fire whether the
# result is objects (object:true) or arrays (object:false). It used to be
# checked only on the object path, so `object:false` silently disabled it.
# Error CODES are asserted: both runtimes raise csv_extra_field when a row has
# too many fields and csv_missing_field when it has too few.
# No header and no field.names: there is no expected count, so field.exact is
# correctly inert. This is divergence (5) against go/encoding/csv, whose
# FieldsPerRecord needs no header — pinned here so it cannot change silently.
